desc: Read the integer N and the sequence A from standard input.
Sort the sequence A in non-decreasing order.
Compute the sum of the last $k$ elements of the sorted sequence.
Compute the sum of the first $k$ elements of the sorted sequence.
Subtract the sum of the first $k$ elements from the sum of the last $k$ elements and print the result.
Write the Python code to read $N$ and the sequence $A$, sort $A$, calculate $k = N // 2$, compute the result as `sum(A[N-k:]) - sum(A[:k])`, and print the result.
Wrap the code in the specified delimiters.
